controls.title: Logical access security
controls.text: (paraphrase) Logical access security measures protect information assets from unauthorized access, including credential protection and encryption of sensitive data.

controls.title: Boundary protection
controls.text: (paraphrase) Controls protect against threats from outside the system boundary, including securing information transmitted over public networks.

controls.title: Restricting information movement
controls.text: (paraphrase) Transmission, movement, and removal of information is restricted to authorized users/processes and protected in transit.

controls.title: System monitoring
controls.text: (paraphrase) System components are monitored for anomalies indicative of malicious acts, and relevant activity is logged.

controls.title: Change management
controls.text: (paraphrase) Changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures are authorized, designed, developed, tested, approved, and implemented under a change-management process.

controls.title: Processing integrity
controls.text: (paraphrase) Processing is complete, valid, accurate, timely, and authorized.

controls.title: Privacy notice
controls.text: (paraphrase) Notice is provided about the collection, use, retention, disclosure, and disposal of personal information.
